messages:
Anya (Design): quick design review 12 prototype for the rollback point picker is up in figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/rollback-picker :eyes:
Sam (Eng): looked it over. main question: how do we indicate which snapshot the user is picking when there are a lot of tiny deploys?
Maria (PM): customers keep asking for exact timestamp selection. can we support typing a time plus timeline scrub?
Anya (Design): current comp has two modes: timeline scrub + exact timestamp input. scrub shows dots for snapshots, hover tooltip with version id + short changelist. input accepts ISO or friendly like "Mar 3, 14:22".
Lee (A11y): a11y note: hover tooltips aren't keyboard reachable. make scrub dots focusable buttons with aria-describedby linking to same content. ensure focus order matches reading order.
Sam (Eng): scrub dots are a virtualized list; making every dot focusable could be expensive. propose exposing nearest snapshot buttons + an expandable real DOM "History list" with keyboard navigable items.
Anya (Design): agreed. flow: scrub for quick glance, "History list" expands to full snapshots with radio selects. selecting populates timestamp input.
Maria (PM): copy tweak: use "Choose point in time to rollback to" instead of "Pick rollback point". action button: "Rollback to selected version". clearer for non-technical users.
Lee (A11y): add visually-hidden prefix for screen readers for absolute times: "Selected time: March 3rd, 2025, 2:22 PM UTC" so short formats don't confuse.
Sam (Eng): what if selected snapshot is from a different region or model variant? need indicator + warning.
Anya (Design): mock shows small badge: "region: us-west-2" or "variant: quant-v2". mismatch triggers a yellow warning card: "Selected snapshot differs from active deploy 12 fallback behaviour may change. Confirm to proceed."
Maria (PM): add inline help link "What changes on rollback?" to point to docs about caches & KV invalidation.
Sam (Eng): backend will perform validation before rollback and return metadata (region, model, env) plus allowed flag. UI should surface and disable final action if incompatible.
Anya (Design): disabled microcopy: "Rollback unavailable: snapshot stored in a private region. Contact support to proceed."
Lee (A11y): ensure focus visible for dot buttons, radio list, CTA. check contrast for warning card; if <4.5:1 use darker amber.
DeployBot: [deploy-check] snapshot-metadata API healthy. response 84ms.
Maria (PM): should we autosuggest a safe rollback point ("recommended") with star icon to speed restores?
Sam (Eng): service can return a "recommended" flag. UI can pre-select but mark as suggestion.
Anya (Design): mock: star + "Recommended" pill and subtle outline. enter selects.
Lee (A11y): give recommended an accessible name: "Recommended rollback point, selected because recent metrics indicate stability" (aria-label).
Maria (PM): plan: prioritize history list + validation + recommended flag. need copy + a11y sign-off before handoff.
Anya (Design): I'll update figma and push prototype, tag @Lee for a11y pass.
Sam (Eng): I'll stub validation endpoint and provide sample payload for testing.
Lee (A11y): will schedule quick audit once prototype is updated.
Anya (Design): next steps: 1) update figma (Anya) 2) stub API & sample payload (Sam) 3) a11y audit (Lee) 4) copy polish & doc link (Maria). tagging folks for followups. :sparkles:
